name: Sam
source:
Horoscope: Scorpio

Skills: Perceptive, strategic, survivalist

History: A S.Human born of one of the wealthier families in Love Shore. After the birth of his flesh and blood brother, Sam struggled to find a purpose for himself in his family. He turned to crime, scored big and fell from grace. He's now attempting to avoid any more trouble after his release from prison.

Personality: Tongue like a dagger, but wit to back it up.

Flaws: Inferiority complex, reluctantly sensitive, coping through cruelty

Trivia: Sam's favorite brand of smokes are Shoreline Reds.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1410330/Love_Shore/]Steam[/url]]
